title: A screening test for a rare disease
intro: Illustrative data, made up for this book. A = has the disease (prevalence 1 %); B = the test is positive. The test has sensitivity 95 % (P(B|A)) and specificity 95 %, so it is positive for 5 % of people without the disease (P(B|not A)). P(A|B) is the positive predictive value.
